evidence.title: Trump's diesel order may not help farmers and truckers with fuel prices

occurrences.checkable_against: Trump executive order and Internal Revenue Service implementing guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Henry Hanscom, American Trucking Associations chief advocacy and public affairs officer, pointed out that the executive order directs temporary penalty relief and potential tax deferral for using red-dyed diesel, not outright tax forgiveness.
occurrences.speaker: Henry Hanscom
occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: Dyed diesel pump-station infrastructure and fueling-capacity records
occurrences.quote_span: But not all dyed diesel pump stations are set up for larger trucks like semis, said Paul Mitchell, a professor of agricultural and applied economics at the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
occurrences.speaker: Paul Mitchell
occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: State dyed-diesel laws and commercial carrier routes
occurrences.quote_span: A national carrier crossing five or six states in a day faces enormous risk with a patchwork of rules, legal in one state, and subject to fines in the next.”
occurrences.speaker: Patrick De Haan
occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: Diesel consumption by user type and dyed-diesel usage records
occurrences.quote_span: “The largest diesel users are the least likely to use dyed diesel,” he wrote.
occurrences.speaker: Patrick De Haan
occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: Diesel purchases and costs of independent truckers after the dyed-diesel policy
occurrences.quote_span: Easing limits on red-dyed diesel will likely have a minimal effect for small truckers, who pay for fuel up front, said Todd Spencer, president and CEO of trade group the Owner-Operator Independent Drivers Association.
occurrences.speaker: Todd Spencer
occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: Global diesel production, inventories and supply restoration data
occurrences.quote_span: “Getting that world supply back up again is going to be, I think, at least a year, even in the best cases.”

occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. national diesel price records and the executive order's tax provisions
occurrences.quote_span: “In the context of diesel prices that are over two dollars more than they were last year, it just doesn’t come close to closing that wound,” said Matt Perdue, president of the North Dakota Farmers Union.
occurrences.speaker: Matt Perdue
occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: Independent trucker fuel-cost records and the Owner-Operator Independent Drivers Association estimate
occurrences.quote_span: He estimates every $1 increase per gallon in fuel costs independent truckers about $400 more per week.
occurrences.speaker: Todd Spencer
occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: Trucking-company fuel costs and state dyed-diesel rules after the executive order
occurrences.quote_span: The effect is likely to be negligible for big trucking companies because the order is on a federal level and states make their own rules, Patrick De Haan, head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy, wrote in a social media post.
occurrences.speaker: Patrick De Haan
occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: Strait of Hormuz and Russia-Ukraine conflict developments affecting diesel supply
occurrences.quote_span: “The problem we’ve accumulated right now with the Strait of Hormuz and the Russia-Ukraine war, those are going to be longer term things to get fixed,” he said.

occurrences.subject: Impact of U.S. dyed diesel policy on fuel users

occurrences.checkable_against: Dyed diesel prices, sales and demand after the executive order

occurrences.checkable_against: Global diesel supply and inventory data

occurrences.speaker: Gregg Ibendahl
